name: Ovidius (Blood for Love)
detailed_description:
Step into a world where love is war, and every heartbeat could be your last. Ovidius’ Blood for Love is a choice-driven adult visual novel set in a decadent, Roman-inspired empire teeming with political schemes, forbidden passion, and razor-edged betrayal. Craft your destiny in a story where romance and survival collide—and no ally, lover, or throne is safe.

You are a general of the Roman Empire, torn between your forbidden love for the Princess and the deadly ambitions of her brother, the Prince. Seduce allies, outwit rivals, and navigate a web of lies where every choice-from whispered promises to blood-soaked alliances-shapes your fate.

  • 🩸 Adult Choices with Consequences: Engage in steamy romance, ruthless scheming, or both—but tread carefully. One wrong move could end in heartbreak… or execution.

  • 👑 Branching Narrative: Decisions that steer relationships, unlock secret endings, and determine who sits on the throne (or dies in the shadows).

  • 🎭 Rich visuals and atmosphere: Stunning 2K images that bring to life opulent palaces, tense confrontations and intimate moments, paired with a haunting original score.

content_descriptors.notes:
This adult visual novel contains mature themes and explicit content. 
Graphic Combat: Scenes of sword fights, gladiatorial-style battles, and bloodshed. Wounds, blood splatter, and fatal injuries are shown stylistically.

Emotional/Physical Conflict: Themes of betrayal, political manipulation, and lethal power struggles.

 Sexual Content:

Explicit Consensual Scenes: Intimate, adult-rated moments between characters (textually described). These scenes are optional and can be avoided.

Passion-Driven Storylines: Romantic relationships with steamy dialogue and seduction as part of courtly intrigue.

Topics NOT Present:

No depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual acts, self-harm, or substance abuse.

While the story explores betrayal and moral ambiguity, it does not glorify abuse or exploitation.
